questions.q: How soon do you expect ____ for South America?
questions.zh: 你希望再過多久前往南美洲？
questions.explain: expect to + V（希望做…）

questions.q: It is useless for you ____ to do this.
questions.zh: 你想要做這事是徒勞無益的。
questions.explain: It is useless + to + V（做…是無用的）

questions.q: I hope ____ to the birthday party tonight.
questions.zh: 我希望今晚能前往參加生日晚會。
questions.explain: hope + to + 原形動詞 ⇒ hope + to be able to + 原形動詞（希望能…）

questions.q: It is too late ____ there.
questions.zh: 我們走到那裡太晚了。
questions.explain: too + 形 + (for + 人) + to + V（對某人太…無法…）

questions.q: He warned me ____ swimming alone because of the rain.
questions.zh: 他警告我不要獨自去游泳，因為外面下著大雨。
questions.explain: warn + (人) + not to + V ⇒ 警告人不要…

questions.q: The manager ordered the work ____.
questions.zh: 經理下令立刻做這件工作。
questions.explain:
① order + (人) + to + V ⇒ 命令(人)做事情
② order + (事) + to be + p.p. ⇒ 下令(事情)被做

questions.q: He finds it easy ____ English as a foreign language.
questions.zh: 他認為以外語而言英語容易學。
questions.explain: it 為形式受詞，to learn 為真正受詞。

questions.q: I think it a good habit ____ early in the morning.
questions.zh: 我認為早上起得早是好習慣。
questions.explain: it 為形式受詞，to get up 為真正受詞。

questions.q: All the clerks in the bank stopped ____ to look at him.
questions.zh: 銀行裡所有的職員都停止了寫字，眼睛盯著他。
questions.explain: stop + V-ing（停止做某事）

questions.q: I am sorry, but I forgot ____ the candy you wanted.
questions.zh: 很抱歉我忘了買你要的糖果。
questions.explain: forget to + V（忘了做…）

questions.q: Having worked for several hours, the manager stopped ____ a rest.
questions.zh: 工作了幾個鐘頭之後，經理停止工作，開始休息。
questions.explain:
① stop + to take a rest（停下來休息）
② stop + taking a rest（停止休息）

questions.q: When your country calls you for help, you cannot but ____.
questions.zh: 當你的國家需要你的幫助，你就不得不去了。
questions.explain: cannot but + 原形動詞（不得不）

questions.q: The lazy young man does nothing but ____ all day long.
questions.zh: 這懶惰的年輕人整天無所事事，只是在玩。
questions.explain: do/does/did nothing but + 原形動詞（只是…）

questions.q: You had better ____ what he has to say.
questions.zh: 你最好聽聽他要說些什麼。
questions.explain: had better = may as well + 原形動詞（最好）

questions.q: You had better ____ Mary about the party. It's a surprising birthday party for her.
questions.zh: 你最好不要告訴瑪麗有關宴會的事。這是要給她一個驚喜的生日宴會。
questions.explain: had better not + 原形動詞（最好不要…）

questions.q: When I was young, I ____ play tennis quite well.
questions.zh: 年輕時，我的網球打得很好。
questions.explain: used to + 原形動詞（以前…）

questions.q: People ____ drink tea, but now more people like coffee.
questions.zh: 人們以前喜歡喝茶，但現在越來越多的人喜歡喝咖啡。
questions.explain: used to + 原形動詞（以前慣於…）

questions.q: The mother watched her children ____ on the yard.
questions.zh: 母親看著她的孩子在庭院中玩耍。
questions.explain: watch + (人) + V-ing（看著人正在做…）

questions.q: I can hear the girl ____ in the next room.
questions.zh: 我可以聽到隔壁的女孩在唱歌。
questions.explain: hear + 受詞(人) + V-ing ⇒ 表示「進行」。

questions.q: There is something wrong with the engine. We must have it ____ at once.
questions.zh: 引擎有點毛病，我們必須立即送修。
questions.explain: have + 物 + p.p.（使某物被…）

questions.q: I tried very hard, but I couldn't make myself ____ these English sentences.
questions.zh: 我很努力地試著，但我無法使自己了解這些英語句子。
questions.explain:
make oneself understand + N（使自己了解…）
make oneself understood（使別人了解自己的話）

questions.q: He is still unable to make himself ____ in English; his English is too poor.
questions.zh: 他仍然無法用英語明白地表達自己的意思；他的英語太差了。
questions.explain: 參考 21 題說明。make oneself understood（使別人了解自己的意思）。

questions.q: I don't know him well enough ____ borrow money from him.
questions.zh: 我還沒有跟他熟得足以向他借錢。
questions.explain:
① enough to（足以～）
② so as to = in order to ⇒ 表示「目的」。

questions.q: She is so foolish ____ cry over a novel.
questions.zh: 她真蠢，竟然邊看小說邊哭。
questions.explain: so + 形/副 + as to + 原形動詞（如此～以致）

questions.q: Come closer ____ we can see you better.
questions.zh: 靠近些以便我們能將你看得更仔細些。
questions.explain: so that + 主詞 + may...（為了…）

questions.q: I am sorry ____ you the other day.
questions.zh: 很抱歉幾天前冒犯了你。
questions.explain: the other day「幾天前」表示過去，對過去的事應用不定詞完成式 to have p.p.。

questions.q: It's ____ day to waste. Let's go for a walk.
questions.zh: 天氣太好了，不容浪費。我們出去走走吧。
questions.explain: too + 形 + a + 名 + to（太…無法）

questions.q: The words on the wall are ____ be recognized.
questions.zh: 牆上的字太模糊而無法辨認。
questions.explain:
① too + 形/副 + to + 原形動詞（太…無法）
② vague 形 模糊的

questions.q: "Shall I walk you home?" "I don't mind if you do, but you don't ____."
questions.zh: 「我陪你走回家好嗎？」「如果你願意的話，我不反對。但是，你無需費這個心。」
questions.explain: You don't have to. = You don't have to (do so). 不定詞 to 之後的動詞若相同時，可以省略不寫。

questions.q: It is ____ over spilt milk.
questions.zh: 覆水難收。
questions.explain:
It is no use + V-ing（無用；無益）
It is of no use + to V

questions.q: ____ to give up a bad habit.
options: It is not difficult for me
questions.zh: 要我戒掉壞習慣並不會很困難。
questions.explain: difficult 為非人稱形容詞，主詞應用 It，不可用「人」。

questions.q: I admit it was foolish of me ____ what you hinted at.
questions.zh: 我承認我實在太笨了竟然不了解你暗示的一切。
questions.explain:
① It is + 形容詞 + of + 人 + to + V...
② hint at（暗示）；否定詞 not 置於 to 之前。

questions.q: He intended ____ abroad last year, but his mother suddenly fell ill.
questions.zh: 他原打算去年出國的，但他母親那時突然病了。
questions.explain: 主詞 + 希望動詞(過去簡單式) + to have + p.p.（過去希望…但未達成）

questions.q: Every time cigarettes go up in price, many people try ____.
questions.zh: 每逢香菸漲價，許多人設法戒菸。
questions.explain:
① 人 + try to + 原形動詞（設法…；盡力…）
② stop smoking（戒菸）

questions.q: If people are unwilling to hear you, ____ to hold your tongue.
questions.zh: 如果人們不願意聽你說，你最好三緘其口。
questions.explain:
① 主詞 + had better + 原形動詞
② It is better (for + 人) to + 原形動詞（最好）
③ hold one's tongue（閉口）

questions.q: Because of air pollution being greatly reduced, this city is still ____.
options: a good place which to live
a good place to live in
questions.zh: 由於空氣污染大大減低，這座城市仍然是居住的好地方。
questions.explain:
① to live in 為形容詞片語，修飾 place。
② (A) 應改作 a good place in which we can live。

questions.q: "I'll help you whenever you need me." "Good. I'd like ____ me tomorrow."
questions.zh: 「無論何時你需要我，我都會幫助你的。」「好，我想你明天來幫我。」
questions.explain: 不定詞 to help 做 you 的受詞補語。like + to-V ／ like + O + to-V

questions.q: "What did you hear last night?" "I seemed ____ someone knock at the door."
questions.zh: 「昨晚你聽到什麼？」「我好像聽到有人在敲門。」
questions.explain:
① 因為是過去的事，故用完成式不定詞。
② 本句 = It seemed that I had heard someone knock at the door.

questions.q: John said that he had to run in order ____.
options: that he can catch the bus
to the bus he could catch
questions.zh: 約翰說他為了趕公車不得不跑步去。
questions.explain: in order to + 原形動詞（為了）表示「目的」。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依中文提示在空格中填入適當的字詞

questions.q:
做一個發明家需要具備豐富的想像力。
____ rich imagination ____ be an inventor.
questions.zh: 做一個發明家需要具備豐富的想像力。
questions.explain: It takes... to + V（需要；花費…）

questions.q:
我原本希望在機場能遇見你。
I hope to ____ ____ you at the airport.
questions.zh: 我原本希望在機場能遇見你。
questions.explain: hope to + have p. p. 表示「過去未實現之願望」

questions.q:
你所要做的就是耐心地等著。
____ you have to do is ____ ____.
questions.zh: 你所要做的就是耐心地等著。
questions.explain: All (人) have/has to do is + 原形動詞（只要…就可以了）

questions.q:
早睡早起有益於健康。
It is good for health ____ ____ early hours.
questions.zh: 早睡早起有益於健康。
questions.explain: keep good/early hours（早睡早起）

questions.q:
我們抵達的時候，天已經黑了，更糟的是我們忘掉了住址。
It was dark when we got there; ____ ____ ____ ____, we forgot the address.
questions.zh: 我們抵達的時候，天已經黑了，更糟的是我們忘掉了住址。
questions.explain: what's worse（更糟的是）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 有句格言說：活到老，學到老。
questions.hint: 有句格言說：As a saying goes
questions.answer: As a saying goes, "It's never too old to learn."
questions.zh: 有句格言說：活到老，學到老。
questions.explain:
It is never too old to learn.
= One is never too old to learn.
= One is never so old that he may not learn.
= Live and learn.

questions.q: 要過一個充實的生活我們應多讀書。
questions.hint: 充實的生活：a full life; an enriched life
questions.answer: In order to live a full life, we should read more books.
questions.zh: 要過一個充實的生活我們應多讀書。
questions.explain:
= To lead a full (或 enriched) life, we should read more books.
= We should read more books so that we may lead a full life.

questions.q: 有些人讀書是為了追求知識。
questions.answer: Some (people) read books in order to get (pursue) knowledge.
questions.zh: 有些人讀書是為了追求知識。
questions.explain:
= Some (people) read books to acquire knowledge.
= Some (people) read books so that they may get knowledge.

questions.q: 有些人讀書則只是為了興趣。
questions.answer: Other people do so (或 read books) just for pleasure.
questions.zh: 有些人讀書則只是為了興趣。
questions.explain:
= Others do so (或 read books) just for pleasure.
【說明】「有些…，有些…」：Some..., others...

questions.q: 老實說，養成讀書的習慣是很好的。
questions.answer: Frankly speaking, it is good to cultivate the habit of reading.
questions.zh: 老實說，養成讀書的習慣是很好的。
questions.explain: = To tell the truth, it is good to form (或 build up) the habit of reading.

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions: 閱讀下列短文，選出最適當的答案填入各題空格中
sections.passage: Many Chinese students ever made up their minds __1__ English when they began to learn it. However, a few months later, they found __2__ not so easy to master English as they __3__ before. Of course, there is no royal road to __4__. In my opinion, Chinese students should first of all form the good habit __5__ dictionaries whenever __6__ any difficulty in learning it. Secondly, they had better take good advantage of their vacation __7__ a trip to foreign countries so that they may widen their knowledge about English. But, the best way __8__ it is __9__ more, speak more, listen more and write more. As it plays a very important role in international affairs, the English language is really well worth __10__.
vocabulary_notes: 1. made up one's mind（下定決心）
2. not so... as + S + V（不如／不像…那樣…）
4. In my opinion = To my mind（以我的看法）
6. take advantage of = make use of（利用；善用）
8. play a very important role in（在…方面扮演非常重要的角色）
10. be well worth + V-ing（很值得）= be well worthy to be + p.p. = be well worthy of being + p.p.

questions.q: Many Chinese students ever made up their minds ____ English when they began to learn it.
questions.zh: 許多學生在開始學英語時，都下定決心要學好它。
questions.explain:
① make up one's mind to + V（下決心要…）= be determined to + V
② be good at（精通）；be bad at（拙劣）

questions.q: However, a few months later, they found ____ not so easy to master English as they had thought before.
questions.zh: 然而，幾個月之後，他們發現要精通英語並不如之前想像的那麼容易。
questions.explain: 句型：S + find + it（形式受詞）+ 形/名 + to V（真正受詞）

questions.q: ...not so easy to master English as they ____ before.
questions.zh: 不如他們之前所想的那樣容易。
questions.explain:
① think-thought-thought（思考；認為）
② think/thought of + 名詞（想到…）
③ 比過去先(早)發生的，用過去完成式 (had + p.p.)

questions.q: Of course, there is no royal road to ____.
questions.zh: 當然，學問無捷徑。
questions.explain:
① There is no royal road to learning.（學問無捷徑。）
② learning 名詞（知識；學問）

questions.q: In my opinion, Chinese students should first of all form the good habit ____ dictionaries whenever they meet any difficulty in learning it.
questions.zh: 以我的看法，學生首先應該養成在學習遇到困難時查閱字典的好習慣。
questions.explain:
① form the habit of + V-ing（養成…習慣）
② consult dictionaries（查閱字典）

questions.q: ...whenever ____ any difficulty in learning it.
questions.zh: 每當學習遇到困難時。
questions.explain:
句型：... whenever they meet any difficulty...
= ... whenever meeting any difficulty...

questions.q: Secondly, they had better take good advantage of their vacation ____ a trip to foreign countries so that they may widen their knowledge about English.
questions.zh: 其次，他們最好善用假期到國外旅行，以便增進對英語的了解。
questions.explain: to take a trip (a travel/a journey)（旅行；旅遊），不定詞表目的。

questions.q: But, the best way ____ it is to read more, speak more, listen more and write more.
questions.zh: 但是，精通英語最好的方法是多讀、多說、多聽和多寫。
questions.explain: to master it 作形容詞修飾主詞 the best way。

questions.q: But, the best way to master it is ____ more, speak more, listen more and write more.
questions.zh: 是多讀、多說、多聽和多寫。
questions.explain: to read more 放 Be 動詞之後作主詞補語 (SC)。

questions.q: As it plays a very important role in international affairs, the English language is really well worth ____.
questions.zh: 因為它在國際事務中扮演非常重要的角色，英語確實非常值得我們學習。
questions.explain:
be well worth our learning（很值得我們學習）
= be well worthy to be learned (by us)
= be well worthy of being learned (by us)
